declared_settings.centre: the observed entry bid/ask midpoint, identical for every variant
declared_settings.coverage_denominator: the AUTHORITATIVE capture-window rules and session calendar; never the export's counts, rows or quotes
declared_settings.coverage_invariant: scored_in_plan <= observed_entries_in_plan <= planned_opportunities; late quotes counted separately
declared_settings.isolated_invocation: every documented command runs under python3 -I from the repository root; checked by subprocess in tests/test_cli_smoke.py
declared_settings.pinned_expectation_guard: the SHA-256 digest decides whether an assertion runs; the provenance label is recorded, never used to skip
declared_settings.schedule_manifest_validation: validated AGAINST the authoritative grid; a slot outside the grid, a duplicate, a malformed row or no usable row makes it invalid, and rows that do not cover the grid make it a mismatch. Either way the plan is preserved and diagnostic coverage is reported while usable coverage is withheld
